text: Nen Lunes, saray scientist manlapud Stanford University School of Medicine et inyanunsyo da so pangimbento na sakey a balon panag-diagnose ya sarag ton ibiig iray type na selula: sakey ya melmelag ya chip ya sarag ton nai-print panamegley na maslak iran inkjet printer ya posiblin manga sakey ya U.S. centavo kada sakey.
eng_text: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Ibabaga na saray manunan researcher ya lapud saya et nayarin mas masakbay ya na-detect so cancer, tuberculosis, HIV tan malaria ed saray pasyente diad mairap iran bansa, ya say nabibilay labat ed saray walaan na sakit ya singa say breast cancer et manga kapaldua no ikompara ed mayaman iran bansa.
eng_text: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Ginmapo so protesta na manga 11:00 base ed oras na bansa ra (UTC+1) diad Whitehall ya arap a mismo na guardiadoy pulis ya lolooban paarap ed Downing Street, say opisyal ya panaayaman na Prime Minister.
eng_text: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Pasado 11:00 ni labat et dakdakel la ray managprotesta diad bandad norte ya dalan ed Whitehall.
eng_text: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Nen 11:20 la, imbaga na saray pulis ed saray manproprotesta ya onggilig irad dalan, kuanto ya dapat iyan dad lugar so kanepegan dan manprotesta lapud panlalapuan lay traffic so gagawaen da.
eng_text: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Nen 11:29, akasabi lad Whitehall iray managprotesta, alampasan da lay Trafalgar Square, pati say Strand, dinmalan irad Aldwych ya anggad Kingsway paarap ed Helborn ya kawalaan na hotel ya Grand Connaught Rooms ya ditan gaganapen so Spring Forum na Conservative Party.

eng_text: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

eng_text: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

eng_text: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

eng_text: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

eng_text: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Asarag nen Mr Reid ya i-drive so kotse ya Black Beauty na team ya A1GP diad New Zealand, ya aminpiton beses tan walaan na peles ya 160 kilometro kada oras.
eng_text: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Diad pansampot na 3 bulan, masulok ya 80 ya naaresto so imbulos ed pasilidad na Central Booking ya aga pormal ya akasoan.
eng_text: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Nen Abril diad sayan taon, sakey ya temporaryon restraining order so inisyu nen Judge Glynn laban ed pasilidad pian ibulos iramay indeteni na masulok ya 24 oras ya anggapoy naawat a hearing na komisyoner na korte.
eng_text: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Say komisyoner so mangiparaay piyansa, no naabuloyan, tan gawaen to lan pormal so pangaakusa ya insumite na arresting officer. Saray pangaakusa so ipasok ed state's computer system ya ditan so pansubaybayan ed kaso.
eng_text: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Say hearing et mananda met ed petsa ed kanepegan na suspek parad maples ya pambista.
eng_text: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Si Peter Costello, say treasurer na Australia tan malamang ya onsublay ya onsalat ed si John Howard bilang lider na Liberal party, et sinuportaan toy nuclear power industry ed Australia.
eng_text: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Inkuan nen Mr Costello ya no say nuclear power generation et aliwan magastos, usaren iya na Australia.
eng_text: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "No magmaliw itan ya komersyal, kaukolan tayo la itan. Agak onkontra ed satay nuclear energy" kuan nen Mr Costello.
eng_text: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

eng_text: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Imbagay pulis ya si Lo Piccolo et mas atagey so posisyon to ta sikatoy right-hand man nen Provenzano diad Palermo tan mas dakel iray eksperiensya to kanian sikatoy rerespetoen na saray mas matatken iran henerasyon na saray boss legan dan tutumbokey totontonen nen Provenzano ya manpaabeba ra anggad posible balet pabibiskegen day power network da.
eng_text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

eng_text: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

eng_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Say Brazil et sankabalegan ya Romano Katolikon bansa diad Dalin, tan say Simbaan na Romano Katoliko et talagan kontra ed legal ya panasawa na parehon sekso ed bansa.
eng_text: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Say National Congress ed Brazil et 10 ya taon dan nandebatian so inkalegal na satan, tan satan ya panangasawa ed sibil et kaplesan ya legal labat ed Rio Grande do Sul.
eng_text: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Say orihinal ya bill et insulat na datin mayor ed São Paulo ya si Marta Suplicy. Say nipropose ya legislatura, no kayarin naamiendaan, et wala lad pakauley nen Roberto Jefferson.
eng_text: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Saray manproprotesta et manilalo ya makatipon na bilang na petisyon ya 1.2 milyon a pirma pian ipresenta ed National Congress no Nobyembre.

text: Sanen dakdakel lan pamilya so onkekerew na legal ya tulong pian ag-ira napaekal ed ayaman da, walay agawan miting nen Marso 20 diad East Bay Community Law Center parad saray biktima na housing scam.
eng_text: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Sanen ibabaga na saray manguupa so agawa ed sikara, maslak ya pamilyan nalalanor et bigla dan naisip ya si Carolyn Wilson na OHA et tinakew toy security deposits da tan tinmakas la ed baley.
eng_text: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Manisia iray manguupa ed Lockwood Gardens ya ompan wala ni 40 ya pamilya odino masulok ni ya nayarin napaekal ed ayaman da, lapud naamtaan da ya saray pulis na OHA et iimbestigaan da met iray public housing ed Oakland ya posiblin erelen lapud housing scam.
eng_text: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

eng_text: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Saray sikat ya Griegon abogado, si Sakis Kechagioglou tan George Nikolakopoulos et inkulong ed prisoan na Korydallus diad Athens, lapud sikaray guilty ed graft tan corruption.
eng_text: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

eng_text: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Diad apalabas iran simba, kayarin in-publish na journalist a si Makis Triantafylopoulos so impormasyon ed sikat ya palabas to ed TV ya “Zoungla” diad Alpha TV, say miyembro na Parliament tan abogado ya si Petros Mantouvalos et inekal ed pwesto lapud saray miyembro ed opisina to et asangkot ed illegal graft tan corruption.

text: Si Hitoshi Saito, sakey ya Japanese judoka tan analo na gold medal ed duaran Olympic, et inatey diad edad ya 54.
eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Say sengegay impatey to et intrahepatic bile duct cancer.
eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Sikatoy inatey ed Osaka nen Martes.
eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Si Saito so all Japan Federation Committee chairman tan sakey met ya datin World Olympic champion sanen sikatoy inatey.
eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Manga 100 ya totoo so inmatendi ed party, pian selebraan so unonan anibersaryo na sanasawa ya nankasal nen imbeneg ya taon.
eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Wala lay aka-eskedyul ya petsa na pormal ya okasyon na anibersaryo, so imbaga na saray opisyal.
eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Nankasal so sanasawa ed Texas nen imbeneg ya taon tan linma rad Buffalo pian manselebra kaibay kakaaro tan kakanayon.
eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Samay asawan laki ya man-edad na 30, ya inyanak ed Buffalo, et sakey ed saray apatiran apatey ed paltogan, balet agasakitan imay asawa to.
eng_text: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Si Karno et kabkabat balet kontrobersiyal a English tutor ya nambangat ed silong na Modern Education tan King's Glory ya mangibabagan walay 9, 000 students ed kapantokan na karera to.
eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Ed saray nota to sikatoy angusar na saray salita ya parad saray atateng et magasal, tan sikatoy nireport ya manguusar na kabandayan ed klase.
eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Sikatoy inakusahan na Modernon Edukasyon et pampriprinta na angkakabaleg ya advertisement diad saray bus ya anggapoy pakauley tan mantitila diad pangibabagan sikatoy manunan English tutor.
eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Sikatoy inakusahan met ed apalabas na copyright infringement, balet ag asentensiaan.
eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Imbaga na datin estudyante ya sikatoy 'angusar na slang ed klase, nambangat na dating skills ed notes, tan singa kaaaro na estudyante.'
eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Legan na taloran dekada, anggaman talagan nansiansia so estandon komunista, say China et akapamawala na ekonomya a saliwan.
eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Say unaan ya pananguman ed ekonomya et agawa diad pananguley nen Deng Xiaoping.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Manlapud saman, say ekonomya na China et binmaleg na 90 beses.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Diad unonan pankanawnawa, nen imbeneg a taon akapangilako so China na mas dakel a kotse nen say Germany tan apalumbasan toy United States ya sankabalegan ya nailalako ed sayan industriya.
eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Say GDP na China et mas balbaleg nen say United States diad loob na duaran dekada.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Say maksil a bagyo ya Danielle, say komapat ed nginaranan a bagyo na 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, et abuo diad mamabukig na Atlantic Ocean.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Say bagyo, et walad manga 3,000 milya manlapud Miami, Florida, ya say sankapelesan a batik na dagem et 40 mph (64 kph).
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Naamtaan na saray sayantista ed National Hurricane Center ya lalon ombiskeg tan onggawan bagyo si Danielle no Mierkules.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Lapud arawi so pelagan na bagyo, nansiansian mairap ya amtaen no panon kakasil so epekto ed United States odino diad Caribbean.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Inyanak ed kabisera na Croatia, si Zagreb, Bobek et akagamor na inkabantog legan na panggalaw ed Partizan Belgrade.
eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Sikatoy akilad sikara nen 1945 tan nansiansian anggad 1958.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Legan na panaon to kaibay grupo, sikatoy akagaway 403 goals ed 468 ya panagtira.
eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Anggapoy siopaman ya akagaway mas dakel a panagtira odino mas dakel a score parad club nen say Bobek.
eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Nen 1995 sikatoy binoto bilang sankanayarian ya gumagalaw diad history na Partizan.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Saray selebrasyon et ginmapo ya walaan na espesyal ya palabas ya ginawa na world-renowned ya grupon Cirque du Soleil.
eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Tinumbokan iya na Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, Janissary band, tan na saray managkasionan Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.
eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Tan linma met ed stage so Whirling Dervishes.
eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Say Turkish diva Sezen Aksu et nanperform met kaibay Italian tenor Alessandro Safina tan Greek singer Haris Alexiou.
eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Pian sumpalen, Turkish dance group Fire na Anatolia ginawa day palabas ya "Troy".
eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Si Peter Lenz, 13-year old ya managpabatik na motor, et inatey sanen akilad Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Legan na warm-up lap to, sikatoy atumbad bisikleta, tan akabil na kaiba ton managpabatik na motor si Xavier Zayat.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Sikatoy tampol ya inasikaso na on-track medical staff tan inyakar ed asingger a ospital balet ta inatey lanlamang.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Agasakitan si Zayat ed aksidente.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Nipaakar ed samay pinansyal ya kipapasen na mundo, intuloy ya imbaga nen Zapatero ya "say sistema na pinansiyal et parte na ekonomiya, mairap a parte."
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Walaan itayo na year-long financial crisis, ya agaylay irap a momento ed apalabas a duaran bulan, tan natan amtak ya ongagapo lan makarecover so financial markets.
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Nen imbeneg ya simba, nibaIitad amin ya bigIaan so indakeI na internationaI ya Ienguahe ya nigangan ed saray reporters so mangawa na baIon taIoran baIita.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: NibabaIita Iad English tan Japanese, et say sangkamundoan ya organisasyon so mangipaay na Spanish, Italian, tan Korean-language ya programa, parad teIevision, say eb, tan diad saray CeIIphone.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Maong ta angapo met sa agawa ed siak, baIet naimatonan toray totoon singara mamatey diad impanaIi dan deraIen iray bintana pian makapaway.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Binebetag na saray toto so saImin panamgIey na saray yurongan, baIet saray bintana so maIet.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Sakey ya saIming so abetag tan pinmaway irad bintana," so imbaga na akaIiktar na si Franciszek Kowal.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Saray bitewen so onerep Iapud eneheya ya ginawa na hydrogen atom tan natekep(or fused) pian mamawaIa na mas ambeIbeIat ya eIemento.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Saray Scientists so mantratrabaho pian makagawa na reactor ya panIapuay eneheiya sa kapara to.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Saya , anggaman ontan so mairap ya gaewen tan kaukoIay dakeI ya taon pian makagaway mausar na fusion reactor.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Say dagum so onIetaw ed tapew na danum Iapud surface tension.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Say Surface tension so nagawa Iapud say water molecules diad tapew na danum so man attrack ed baIang sakey ya mas ni Iapud air molecules ed tapew da.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Say Surface tension so nagawa Iapud say water molecules diad tapew na danum so man attrack ed baIang sakey ya mas ni Iapud air molecules ed tapew da..
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Sa bIade na modernon ice skate so waIaan tarem ya waIay nikutIaong ed nipegIay. Saray duaran tarem so makasengeg ya mapeket ed yeIo, angano ompariking.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Lapud say daIem na tarem et waIay daiset ya paIiko to kanian no ompariking ed biek kon biek say tarem so ombeka met ya paIiko.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Saya so rason no akin ya no skate so onIiko ed kawanan, say skater so onIiko met ed kawanan. No skate et onIiko ed kawigi say skater so onIiko met ed kawigi.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pian napapawiI da so datin sukat na biskeg da, nakaukoIan ya arawian da so Iiwawa.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Nagagawaan diad pangibuga da na meIag iran kabiangan na Iiwawa ya tatawagey "photon".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Tatawagen iya na saray Scientists ya proseso ya' " pamakasiI na buga na radiation" Iapud say atom so napapakasiI panamegIey na Iiwawat, ya pinawaIa ya Iiwawa na photon, tan saya Iiwawa et sakey a kIase na radiation.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Diad onsubIay na Iitrato ipapanengneng to ya saray atom so mangibubuga na saray photon. Siempre diad kapetegan to saray photon so mas memeIag nen saray waIad Iitrato.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Saray photon so may memeIag nen saray migmig ya Iapuan na atom!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Kayari niIasus ya oras na panguusar, say fiIament na bombiIya so napuoIan ya anggad agIa nausar.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Say bombeIya so kaukoIan ya saIatan. Imporantin manaIwar ed pansaIat na bombeIya.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Unona, nakaukoIan ya erepen so switch odino i-disconnect so Iinya.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Saya so Iapud say angipeketan na bombeIyan metaI et waIay korente to ya nayarin pirmi kan nakorente no nakarapas mo so bandad daIem to.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Say manunan organo ed circuIatory system et say puso, ya mangibobomba na daIa.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Ompaway so daIa ed puso ya ondaIan ed tubo (artery) tan insan ompawiI ed puso panamegIey na saray uIat(veins). Say tawag ed saray angkeIag ya uIat et capillaries.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Say ngipen na triceratop et aglabat makagatgat na bulong, noagta anggan saray anaw-awet ya sanga tan lamot.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Iisipen na arum ya scientist ya say Triceratops et mamangan na cycads, sakey a klase na tanaman ya kaslakan ed panaon na Cretaceous.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Sarayan tanaman et singa melag a kiew na palma, tan say tuktok to et makdem tan mauutok iran bulong.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Nayarin usaren na Triceratops so mabiskeg ya tepek to pian ekalen iray bulong antis dan kanen so kiew.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Irarason na arum ya scientist ya makasamal iratan ya tanaman, kanian agnayarin kanen na anggan anton klase na dinosaur, anggano natan et kakanen la na sloth tan arum ni ran ayayep a singa say parrot (sakey a nanlapu ed dinosaur) iray makasamal a bulong tan prutas.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Panon ak ya guguyoren na Io gravity? No onalagey kad tapew na Io, mas abebay belat mo nen say wala kad dalin.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Say toon manbelat na 200 pulgada (90kg) ed dalin et magmaliw ya 36 pulgada (16kg) ed Io. Mapatpatnag ya agka tanton aguyor na gravity.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Anggapoy anawet ya parte na Agew ya nayarin gatinan, aliwan singa say dalin. Say interon Agew et ginawa panamegley na saray gas, apoy tan plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Mas oniimpis so gas no paarawi ka ed pegley na Agew.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Say akinpaway a parte ya sankanengneng tayo no onnengneng tayod Agew et tatawagen ya photosphere, ya mankabaliksay "bola na liwawa".
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Nen manga taloran libon taon, 1610, say Italyanon astronomer ya si Galileo Galilei et angusar na teleskopyo pian obserbaan ya say Venus et walay peryodo to, ya singa say bulan.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Nagagaway peryodo lapud sakey diking labat na Venus (odino bulan) ya akaarap ed Agew so naliliwawaan. Sinuportaan na peryodo na Venus so teorya nen Copernicus ya saray planeta et onliliber ed Agew.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Insan kasumpal na pigaran taon nen 1639, naobserbaan na Ingles ya astronomer ya manngaran na Jeremiah Horrocks so inggalaw na Venus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Asali na Inglatera so andukey ya kareenan kasumpal iran nasakop met lamlamang so Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Inarap balet nen Ethelred so balbaleg ya grupo na marino na saray Viking nen 991. Mas baleg ni yan grupo no ikompara ed grupo nen Guthrum, sanlasus taon sakbay to ya.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Say lider na sayan grupo na marino et sakey ya Norwego, si Olaf Trygvasson. Gabay ton nasakop tan ipawil so bansa to manlapu ed impansakop na Denmark.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Akitunosan la si Ethelred ed kinen Olaf kasumpal ya atalo so militar to kanyan simmempet la ed Norway pian naala to ni so panarian to.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Say Hangeul labat so alpabeto ya ginagalan inimbento pian usaren ed inagew-agew. Say alpabeto et inimbento nen 1444 nen manuuley si Arin Sejong (1418 – 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Si Arin Sejong so komapat ya ari na Joseon Dynasty tan sakey ed saray igagalang ya maong.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Say orihinal ya tawag tod alpabeton Hangeul et Hunmin Jeongeum, ya mankabaliksay "say dugan tanol parad pambangat ed saray totoo".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Dakdakel so teorya no panon ya niwalay Sanskrit. Say sakey ed saratan et nipaakar ed impan-migrate na sakey ya Aryan ya nanlapud sagur na India ya inawit toy lenguahe to ed sikara.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Say Sanskrit et lenguahe nensaman tan walay piparaan tod lenguahen Latin ya uusaren ed Europa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Say sankaunaan ya kabkabat ya libro ed mundo et insulat ed lenguahen Sanskrit. Kayarin kinolekta itan na Upanishads, kinmupas so Sanskrit lapud hirarkiya.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Say Sanskrit et komplikadon maong ya lenguahe ya nanlapuan na dakel ya modernon lenguahe na India, singa say Latin ya nanlapuan na saray lenguahe ed Europa singa say French tan Spanish.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Nen asumpal so labanan parad France, ginmapon namparaan so Germany pian salakayen so isla na Britanya.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Say impangataki et tinawag na Germany ya "Operation Sealion". Maslak ya ambebelat ya armas tan suplay na sundalo na Britanya et abalang nen inlikas iratan manlapud Dunkirk, kanian medyo kinmapuy so puersa na militar da.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Balet say Royal Navy et mas mabiskeg nin siansia nen say German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) tan sarasarag ton deralen so anggan anton pansalakay ya barko ya impawit ed English Channel.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Balet, dagdaiset ya barko na Royal Navy so walad asingger ed posible iran ruta ya pansalakayan lapud natatakot iray admiral ya ompan onlereg ira no onataki so German manlapud tagey.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Gapoan tayod paliwawa tungkol ed planoy Italya. Say Italya et ibibilang ya agi na Germany tan Japan.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Mahinay pwersa militar tan say navy to,anggaman walaan na apatiran barko diad gapo na giyera.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Manunan gagala na Italya iray bansa na Africa. Pian nasakop irayan bansa, kakaukolanen da ya walay troop launching pad, pian makapanlayag so troops diad balew na dayat na Mediterranean tan atakien so Africa.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pian ontalona ira, kaukolan ya iwasan da so British bases tan Egypt military ship. Agla kaukolay pibakal na Italya ed saraya.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Say Japan et sakey ya isla ya bansa a singa met Britain.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Saray submarine so denisenyo pian manlakbay ed kaaralman na dayat,tan mansiansia ditan ed piagaran panaon.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Saray submarines so inusar ed World war I tan World War II. Diad saman ya panaon mahinay shooting range da.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Diad umpisay giyera kaslakan so manbiabiahe ed tapew na dayat,nen niwala so radar saray submarine so unlusong ed kaaralman na dayat pian sikaray ag nanengneng.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Say tawag ed German submarines et U-boats.Saray German et ekspertod pangobkob tan pangusar na saray submarines.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Lapud intalonay submarines na saray German kayari bakal et agla ira inabuloyan ya mangusar ed saratan.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Diad modernon panaon kabkabat si "Arin Tutankhamun",ya atawag met ya "Arin Tut "tan" Say Ugaw ya Ari" ed panaon na saray Ehipsio.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Balet agda binidbir so impanuley ton ari ed panaoy Ehipsio tan agda initday importansiya.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Say impakalmo na lubok to nen 1922 so nanresulta ed pagmaliw ton sikat.Karaklan ya lubok nensaman et tinakewan balet say lubok to et agda ginalaw.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Saray item ya kaibad lubok nen Tutankhamun so ag balot agalaw.Kabiangan ed saratan iray ankablin bato tan artefacts.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Saray naimbenton karwahen de gulong na saray Asiryano so amapeles tan mas mag maong ya usaren na saray sundalo pian mibakal.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Saray Asiryano so inmunan angusar na cavalry. Nen manga 1000 B.C., say pana ya uusaren da so talagan ontagos ya maong ed saray kalaban da.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Say kabalyero et sakey ya armada ya akalugan ed kabayo. Agni naimbento so yurongan ya akatapew ed kabayo kanian saray kabalyeroy Assyria et akilaban ya anggapoy apis na beneg na saray kabayo ra.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Dakel so kabkabat ya Griegon politiko,sientista tan artista.Sakey si Homer ya angiambag ed literatura,say Iliad tan Odyssey so sakey ed saray compose to.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Si Sophocles tan Aristophanes et kabkabat ni ran managsadula tan saray drama da et inkonsidera ya sankarakepan diad literatura na mundo.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Sakey nin sikat ya Mathematician ya Griego et si Pythagoras,kabkabat ya maong lapud ginawa ton pythagorean theory.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Nanduruma so ibabaga no panon karakel iray totoon mansasalita na Hindi. Base ed tantiya, saya et walad baetan na komadua tan komapat ed sanka-kaslakan ya nauusar a lenguahe diad intiron mundo.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Nanduruma so bilang na saray totoon mamsasalita ed sayan lenguahe, depende balanglan nibilang iray asingger a maong odino andi iray mipadparan lenguahe.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Say tantiya et walad 340 milyon anggad 500 milyon iray mansasalit, tan nayarin 800 milyon iray totoon makatalos ed sayan lenguahe.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Parehas ed bokabularyo so Hindi tan Urdu balet nandumaan ed estilo na panagsulat; diad agew-agew ya pitotongtong, saray mansasalita ed satan ya duaran lenguahe et natalosan day sakey tan sakey.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Nen manga koma-15 century, say nothern Estonia et impluensyadon maong na Germany.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Wala ray German a monghe ya labay dan iyasingger so Dios ed saray totoo diman, kanian inimbento da so literal a lenguahe na Estonia.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Base itan ed alpabeto na Aleman tan sakey a karakter "Õ/õ" so inyarum.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Diad ilalabas na panaon, dakel ya salita a bayes ed German so inlaok. Saya so gapo na impakaliwawaan.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Singa dati lan gagawaen, say manawir na trono et diretso lan tampol ed pan-military kapan-graduate to.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Balet si Charles et nanaral ed unibersidad diad Trinity College, Cambridge ya ditan inaral to so Anthropology tan Archaeology, tan kabekta et History, ya akala na 2:2 (abebbeba tan onkokomaduan degree ed klase).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Si Charles so sankaonaan ya miembro na British Royal Family ya akala na degree.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Say European Turkey (eastern Thrace odino Rumelia ed Balkan peninsula) et kabiangay 3% na bansa.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Say teritorya na Turkey et masulok ya 1,600 a kilometro (1000 mi) karukey tan 800 km (500mi) kaawang, ya singa rectangle so hugis to.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Say sukat na Turkey, kaiba la ray lawa, et 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), ya say 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) et walad south west Asia tan say 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) et diad Europe.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Lapud kaawang na Turkey et saya so koma-37 ya sankabalegan a bansa diad interon mundo, tan singa kabaleg na impaniban Metropolitan France tan United Kingdom.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Say Turkey et apaliberan na saray dayat so taloran diking to: Aegean Sea diad west, Black Sea diad north tan Mediterranean Sea diad south.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Andukey so history na Luxembourg,nagmaliw ya independent nen 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Karaklan ya parte na Belgium et sakop na Luxembourg,balet nen 1830's inala iya na Belgium kayari Revolution.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Neutral ya bansa so Luxembourg ,abago iya kayari World WarI tan World War II.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Naging member na European Union so Lyxembourg nen 1957.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Say Drukgyal Dzong so aderal ya amotan tan say Buddhist monasteryo diad bandad tagey a parte na Paro District(diad Phondey Village).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Nibagan nen 1649,si Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel so nangawa na amotan pian natalo iray puersa na Tibetan- Mongol.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Nen 1951,apoolan so liber na Drukgyal Dzong balet nansiansia so imahen nen Ngawang Zhabdrung Namgye.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Kayari pool say amootan et nansiansia tan nagmaliw iyan ateaksiyon ed Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Legay na koma-18 ya siglo, say Cambodia so walad baetan na duaran makapanyarin kakaabay, Vietnam tan Thailand.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Aminpigan sinakop na Thai so Cambodia nen 18th century tan dineral da so Pnom Phen nen 1772.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Diad saginonor diad 18th century sinakop met na Vietnam so Cambodia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Eighteen porsyento na Venezuelans so anggapoy trabaho tan say arum et aliwan regular ya nantrabaho.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Say arum ya venezuelan et nantrabahod sector tan agriculture.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Say oil so manunan export na Venezuela anggaman sakey porsiento labat so mantratrabaho ed oil industry.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Saray eksperto na Singapore Botanical Garden so nanparakep ed isla ya nagmaliw ya Garden City.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Si Vanda Miss Joaquim say orchid hybrid so pinili ya national flower nen 1981.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Kada taon na Oktubre mga 1.5 million ya herbivores so ondadayo,ya ondalan ira ed Mara river tan kapalandeyan.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Kapawil ed amianen manlapud sagur,binmaliw ed Ilog Mara kayari maksil ya uran nen Abril.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Say region na Serengeti so walaan na Serengeti National Park,say Ngorongoro Conservation Area,tan say Maswa Game Reserve ed Tanzania tan say Maasai Mara National Reserve ed Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kaukolan so magalang tan tradisyonal no manaral na media,kabiangan so uusaren ya gamit(storyboarding,video and audio editing,story telling,etc.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Diad interactive design et nakaukolan ya nasubok so pankunwari tungkol ed media production tan naaralan so mannunot ed paraan ya non-linear.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Say interactive design et kaukolay pankakasakey balet diad tua kanya ya trabaho.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Komplikado so zoom lenses lapud mankaukolan na dakel ya trabaho antis ya nagawa.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Saray lens manufacturer so akapawala na saray dekalidad ya lens.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Mamapawala na atagey ya kualidad ya litrato so sarayan zoom lenses ya singa kualidad na naalad lenses ya walay fixed focal length.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Sakey ya disadvantage na zoom lenses et say maximum aperture (say peles) na lens so talagay makapoy.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Aliwan mabli so zoom lenses no aga usaray flash.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Sakey ed maslak ya problema no sasalien ya i-convert so sakey ya pelikula pian magmaliw ya DVD so format to et say overscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Maslak ya TV et ginawa pian napaliket so saray publiko.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Kanian nanengneng mo ed TV ya tinabas da so tagey, leksab tan saray dikingan to lapud sayan rason.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Overscan so tawag ed saya. Ginawa ya pian say litrato ed panoen to so intiron screen.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: No mangawa ka balet na DVD, natabas met iray ketegan to tan no say pasen ya subtitle ed video et alekleksab, ag la masyadon nanengneng.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Samay tradisyonal ya kastilyo ed kapegleyan a panaon et abayag a akatulong ed imahinasyon, panagparles na imahen na saray joust, diad saray ponsia, tan na Arthurian chivalry.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Anggaman manalalagey anggano sanlibon taon lan ageray mainomay ya nanonotan iray agawan gira, say ungol na sali na saray ayayep tan say takot ya manlalapud dalem na dalin.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Balet kasin say imahinasyon tayo et base ed katuaan? Manuna ed amin akin ya saray kastilyo et impaalagey? Panon iran dinisenyo tan impaalagey?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Say Kirby Muxloe Castle,et sakey matibay ya abung nen say palasyo.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Say maawang tan atagey ya bintana tan makisir ya dingding et ag makabayag ed determinadon panatake.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ginawa nen 1480's,diad uley nen Lord Hastrings,mareen tan malegen so lugar pwera labat no walaray matakew.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Say inkabalanse so getma na European nation pian pansiansiaen toy pakayari to ed estado.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Say konsepto na nasyon na Europe et agto aboluyan so arum ya bansa ya manalona ed pakapanyari to tan agto met mandedepende ed saray alliance.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Say War of Spanish Succession so namarkay unaan ya giyera ya akatutok ed pakayari.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Walay pananguman ya agawa, say pakayari na Europa et aliwa lan makasengeg ed religious wars. Kanian say Thirty Years' War so otit ya giyeran unor ed relihiyon.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Nen July 21 356 BCE,aderal so Temple of Artemis diad Efeso lapud impantraydor nen Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Sinmanok so saray taga efeso ed si Herostratus,kanian agbalot nirekord so ngaran to.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Aderal so templo ed saman ya agew sanen inyanak si Alexander the great.Say griegon historyador ya si Strado so angingaran ed satan ya templo.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Bilang ari, inoprisi nen Alexander ya ipaalagey so templo, balet ag-inawat so apay to. Kayari impatey to, say templo so nipaalagey nen 323 BCE.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Seguroen ya agnatamaan iray nota,tan agmasyadon magalaw so gamet.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: No oniay gawaen nakesawan ya tampol so lima. Tandaan ya agkaukolan so puersa no pinduten iray nota pian naaruman so volume ed singa diad piano.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Usaren so bellows ya maong tan maples pian onkasil so volume.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Say Mysticism et igamor na communion,sikakabat ed realidad,espitual ya katuaan tan ed Dios.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Say sakey ya mananisia et walaan na pakatebek ed realidad na saray dirios.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Say igamor na marakep ya bilay tan naaralan ed saray eksperiensya so tutumboken.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Say Mysticism et sakey ya porma na reliyon ya manisia ed saray eksperiensya tan saya so nibase ed agawa ed apalabas say impagiiter na sarili pian nawalaan na karrenan tan pakatebek.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Say Sikhism et sakey relihyon ya nalapud rehiyon na Punjabi legay koma-15 ya siglo,saya so akisian ed tradisyon na Hindu.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Bibirin na Sikhs ya nanlapud Hindu iray tradisyon tan lamot.Ikokonsideran na Sikhs so pananisia da ya biig ed Hinduism.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Gurmat so tawag na Sikhs ed relihyon da,parad Punjabi et"way of the gutu"Say guru et sakey ya lusek na amin ya indian religion,balet parad Sikhs,papanisiaan da labat so Sikhism.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Say relihyon et inletneg nen koma-15 ya siglo nen Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Tinmumbok ed nantutumbokan ya siameran guru.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Balet, nen June 1956, asubok iray promisa nen Krushchev nen agaway riot ed Poland sanen nanprotesta iray trabahador lapud kulang so naakan tan binawasan so sueldo ya lapud satan et agaway baleg a protesta sumpad Communism.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Pian ondeen, angibaki si Krushchev na saray tangke tan inmabuloy ed kerew na saray nanprotesta parad maabig ya ekonomiya tan inmabuloy ya turoen so sikat ya si Wladyslaw Gomulka bilang prime minister.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Say Indus Valley Civilization et kabiangay Bronze Age civilization diad baybay-sagur Indian subcontinent ya sasakopen toy karaklan a parte na modernon agew ya Pakistan tan arum a region ed baybay-sagur na India tan baybay-bukig na Afghanistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Inmasenso so panagbilay diad lawak na Indus River a ditan so nanlapuay ngaran to.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Anggaman iisipen na arum ya iskolar ya agawa met so sibilisasyon ed lawak na Sarasvati River ya ekat la natan, duga labat ya natawag ya Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, balet tatawagey arum ya Harappan Civilization kayari Harappa, say unona ed saray lugar to ya akotkot nen 1920's.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Say militaristikon kaugalian na emperyo na Roma et akatulong ed inyaligwas na medisina.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Ginmapon impila nen Emperador Augustus iray doktor tan nanbuo ni ira ingen na sankaunaanan ya Roman Medical corps ya usaren kasumpal na labanan.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Walay amta na saray manag-opera ed nanduruman panpakalma kaiba lay morphine ya nanlapud katas na bukel na poppy tan scopolamine manlapud bukel na herbane.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Nagmaliw iran ekspertod panagputot pian nisalba iray pasyente ed gragrene ontan met ed torniquet tan arterial clamps pian napatunday dala.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Diad inlabas na dakel ya siglo, say emperyo na Romano et inmaligwas ed medisina tan nanlapuan na karaklan ya amta tayo natan.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Say pureland origami et origamin walay restriksyon to ta sakey labat ya tupi so nagawaan, agto sarag so nanduruman tupi, tan amin ya tupi et simple labat.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Aya et ginawa nen John Smith nen 1970 pian tulongan iray ag-eksperiensyadon mantupi odino limitadoy abilidad da.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Saray ugugaw et makatalos ed pangidumaduma na rasa tan saya et angapekta ed ugali da.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Say alimbawa to, saray ugugaw ya mangibibilang ed sarili dan racial minority ya na-stereotype lan aliwan maayos ed eskuelaan et walay tendensya ran aliwan maayos eskuelaan no nalikna ray sterotype dad lahi ra.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: Kumatlo ed saray pinakapopular ya website ya uusaren ed Estados Unidos so MySpace tan walaan na 54 milyon ya profiles natan.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Dakel so akapansin ed sarayan website, lalo la manlapu ed manuusar nipaakar ed edukasyon.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Dakel so positibon aspeto na sarayan website, kaiba ed saraya so mainomay ya i-setup para ed klase ya nayarin itdan na blogs, saray video, litrato, tan arum ni ya features.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Mainomay iyan ikabisa tan i-type na saray estudiante ya nairapan ya mangusar na keyboard odino man-spelling ta naluksan iya diad panamegley na sakey ya web address labat.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Sarag to iyan umanen piano magmaliw iyan mainomay ya basaen tan itdan na dakel odino daiset labat ya kolor.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Say "Attention Deficit Disorder" et sakey ya neurological syndrome ya walaan na taloran symptoms,pabigla bigla,mandidistorbo tan hyperactive.
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Aliwa iyan learning disability noagta learning disorder; aya et "makakaapekto ed 3-5% na saray ugugaw, tan nayarin 2 million ya American."
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Saray ugugaw ya walaan na ADD et mairap ya manpokus ed eskuelaan,balet sikaray marunong ed pangalaw o pansulat tan manbantay na saray cartoons.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Mainomay ya nasagmak irayan ugugaw ed gulo, lapud "walaan ira na ugalin masebeg tan maangat ed autoridad," pian onligsa so utek da ta say utek da et ag napapaligsay metodon normal.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Say ADD et apektaen toy arum ya ugugaw lalod kaedaran da,ag-ira natalosan na arum lapud say level na maturity da et niduma.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Say pakagamor na kakabatan tan panaral ed pananguman so paraan pian say pikakabat et nauman.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Nikadkaduma so igamor na kakabatan.Nanonotan na sakey so desdes legan ya ongagamor na kakabatan balet say abilidad ya nonoten iraya so akapokusan.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Say importante, say Renaissance et binago to so paraan na igamor na kakabatan tan pangibiig ed nanaaralan.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Aliwan singa say bakes,saray hominids so agla ombibitin o manbabaging ed saray kiew.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Saray lima tan sali na chimpanzee et parehon sukat tan tagey, ipapanengneng to iya so usar na saray lima parad panakar.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Saray lima na too et melag so sukat nen saray sali,walaan na gamet.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Saray fossil hand bones ya mantaon na duaran milyon odino taloran milyon so mangibagan walay locomotion tan manipulation na saraya.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Say pankugip ya malinlinew et makapakisaw.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Sakey onaan ya rason ed sayan penomena et resulta na aktibon REM kaplesay ugip.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: No daiset so REM kada yugip say laman so maka-recover manlapud problema.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Makapakesaw no anggapoy duamplo odino talomplon minuton painawa.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Say epekto na kugip et depende diad panag-isip.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Aga mainomay so kipapasen na saray Italyano ed Amianen ya Africa manlapud gapuan. Diad sakey a simba labat kasumpal ya indeklara da so giyera nen a-10 na Hunyo, 1940, asakup na 11th Hussars na Briton so Fort Capuzzo ed Libya.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Narel na saray Briton si Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, Heneral Lastucci dia ed sakey ya ambush ed bandad bokig ya Bardia.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Inatey si Marshal Italo Balbo, Gobernador-Heneral na Libya tan mananawir nen Mussolini, nen 28 na Hunyo lapud aksidenten apaltog na kaiba to met lamlamang legan ya sikato et onsasabi ed Tobruk.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Say modernon isport a fencing et galaw ya walaan na naduruman levels, unona saray estudyante ed unibersidad anggad propesyonal tan diad Olympic a kompetisyon.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Sayan isport ed naigalaw ed duel format, sakey fencer ya maduduwelo ed sakey ni.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Say golf et klase na galaw ya saray manggagalaw et manguusar na baton pian kenaen so bola ya ipaarap ed saray abot.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Waloran abot ed kada regular ya round na galaw, maslak et onggagapo iray manggalaw diad unaan ya abot tan sumpalen da diad koma-labinwalo ya abot.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Say player ya walaan na sankaraisetan na impangikena ed baton pian nasumpal so galaw et panalo.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Sayan galaw et gagawaen diad karikaan, tan say dika ed liber na abot et puputotan tan tatawagen na say birdi.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Nayarin say kaslakan a klase na turismo et samay nikonekta na totoo ed pambiahe: say Recreation tourism.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Saray totoo et onlad sakey a lugar ya duman maong ed inagew-agew ya bilay da pian manrelaks tan manliket.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Diad saray dayat, parke, tan man-camping iray lugar ya maslak a lalaen na saray turista.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: No say gagala na sakey ya ombibisita ed sakey a lugar et pian naamtaan so history tan kultura, sayan klase na turismo et cultural tourism.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Saray turista et nayarin onlad nanduruman kabkabat a lugar ed sakey a bansa odino basta manpokus labat ira ed sakey a lugar.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Nen anengneng itan na saray Colonel, anawag iray ontulong.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Kaibad saray grupo na sundalo ya tinmulong et say 1st tan 3rd New Hampshire ya bubuoen na 200 ya sundalo, ya idadaulo nen Colonel John Stark tan James Reed (a parehon nagmaliw ya heneral).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Saray sundalo nen Stark et pinmuesto ed abay na alar ed aminanan diad bandad sampot ya kawalaan na saray Colonel.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Nen inmabebay danum, nanengneng so baetan na Mystic River tan amagan dalin ya walad abalaten-sagur, kanian tampol dan inaruman so alar panamegley na padir a gawad bato anggad abalaten diad baybay na sakey a melag ya dayat.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Si Gridley odino Stark et angikarga na sakey a poste ya say karukey to et manga 100 feet (30 metro) diad arap na alar tan ingganggan to ya anggapoy mampaputok na paltog anggad makadalan iray sundalo.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Implano iya na America lapud iilaloan da so iyataki na saray alyansa manlapud taloran direksion.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Atakien nen General John Cadwalder iray British ya sundalo diad Bordentown pian naamper so antokaman ya tulong ya onsabi.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Angiganggan si General James Ewing na 700 ya sundalo ed ilog ya walad Trenton Ferry pian nasakop toy taytay ya walad Assunpink Creek tan anggapoy makatakas ya kalaban.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Say 2,400 ya sundalo so ombaliw ed ilog ya siameran milya so kaarawi to ed abalaten na Trenton, insan inapag ira ed duaran grupo, say sakey et indaulo nen Greene tan say sakey et indaulo nen Sullivan, pian makaataki ira antis na palbangon.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Manlapud kapeles na batik ya kakapat ya magmaliw ya ya kapalduan milya, diad satan et agla masyadon importante so kapeles, noagta say inkapaot la so manunan kaukolan.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Syempre, say manunan klase na half-miler et samay too ya nagawaan to itan ed duaran minuto, ya sarag ton talagay ombatik na mapmaples, balet say inkapaot so kaukolan ya pansiansiaen ed amin ya peligro.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Say arum et babatiken da so ararawin pasen diad mairap iran dalan legan na panaoy ambetel, kaiba lay pan-gym parad exercise na kabalgan a parte na laman da, satan so sankaabigan ya preparasyon parad panaon na lumba na batik.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Aliwan magenap so pangan na masustansia iran naakan pian makasabi ed sampot iran kabiangan na kompetisyon, balet baleg so epekto na satan ed kalusugan na saray ugaw nin atleta.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Say pansiansian balanse ed panangan na di-calories iran naakan, iyinum na suston karakel na danum, tan pakatalos ed nanduruman epekto na iyinum na bitamina so makatulong ed performance na saray atleta tan mas na-enjoy day sport.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Say middle-distance ya lumbay batik et aliwan magastos ya sport; balet wala ray duman pakatalos nipaakar ed pigaran kagawaan ya kailangan pian makapibiang.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Nayarin saliwen iray produkto no kaukolan, balet maslak ed saratan et anggapoy masyadon nitutulong tod atleta.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Nayarin say pakalikna na saray atleta et kaukolan da so sakey a produkto anggano anggapo met so nitulong na satan.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Panisiaan ya say atom et sakey ed saray manunan building blocks na amin ya matter.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Sakey iyan komplikadon maong ya pinalsa ya base ed Bohr model et walaan iya na central nucleus ya liliberen na saray electrons, a singa ed ililiber na saray planeta ed agew - nengnengen so Figure 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Say nucleus et tugyopen na duaran kabiangan - say neutrons tan protons.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Say protons et walay positibon charge na kuryente to balet anggapod neutrons. Say electrons et walay negatibon charge na kuryente to.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Antis mon i-check so biktima, kaukolan mo nin siguroen ya say kawalaan mo et ligtas ya lugar.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: No onasingger ka, imanom so posisyon na biktima tan no wala ray nikadkaduman anengneng mo.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: No nasakitan ka anta labay mo labat so ontulong, mas mairap laingen so sitwasyon.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Base ed impanaral, naamtaan ya say depresyon, takot tan panisip ya walay mauges ya nagawa so rason no akin ya makaliknay sakit tan nawalaay deperensyad laman iramay makakalikna na sakit ed beneg.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.
