text: Say epekto na panisip ya walay mauges ya nagawa et depende ed sinimban PA session, agkaibad saya so depresyon tan takot.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Saramay walaan na regular ya gagawaen so mas mankaukolan na tulong lalo lad saray aliway panmoria da ed nalilikna da lapud nanduruman sakit tan no panon dan nadetermina so aliwliwan liknaan ed normal ya liknaan.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Say pakanengneng odino say ablilidad ya makanengneng ed akadepende ed visual system sensory organs odino saray mata.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Dakdakel tan nandurumay inkagawa na saray mata, kaiba lay pagmaliw ton komplikado depende ed kakaukolanen ya organismo.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Say nanduruman inkagawa et walay nandurumay usar to, sensitibo ed nanduruman wave-length tan nandurumay kalinew to, tan kakaukolanen toy nanduruman proseso pian makanengneng na duga tan dugay igana na nanduruman numero.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Say populasyon et tugyop na saray organismo na saray particular a klase ed sakey ya lugar.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: No amin ya indibidwal ed sakey a populasyon et pare-pareho nipaakar ed makapakelaw a katangian, sikaray natawag ya monomorphic.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Sano saray indibidual et manguuman-uman ed kalareker da, sikaray natawag ya polymorphic.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Saray kumpog na tatawagey Army ant et man-martsa tan manubong ed nanduruman lugar.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Diad iyalis-alis da, saray sundalon gilata et manma-martsa diad labi tan ontutunda pian mankampo no agew.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Onggapon onalis-alis iray grupo na gilata no daiset lay naakan da. Legan na sayan panaon, aliwan saksakey so panaayaman da ed kada agew.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Kada iyalis-alis da et abeten toy manga 17 ya agew.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Anto so cell? Say salitan cell et nanlapud salitan Latin ya "cella" a say kabaliksan to et "melag ya kuarto," tan satan so unonan inusar na sakey ya microscopist ya mangoobserba ed inkagawa na cork cells.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Say cell so manunan kabiangan na amin ya mabilay a bengatla, tan amin ya organismo et walaan na sakey o mas dakel nin cell.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Saray cell et manuna tan importante et panaral nipaakar ed bilay, diad tua, saraya so naynay ya tutukoyen ya "say lapuan na bilay na amin ya bengatla."
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Mimintinaen na Nervous System so homeostasis diad pangiiyan na saray nerve signals ed laman pian napansiansia tan tuloytuloy so idaloy na dala.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Sayan nerve impulse so maples ya nibaki ed laman pian protektaan toy laman manlapud mauges.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Saray tornado so maneral ed melag ya lugar labat kompara ed saray bagyo,balet deralen da ya tampol so amin ya dalanen da.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Baguten na tornado so saray kiew, deralen to iray karatola ed building, patikyaben to iray luganan. Say sankakasilan ya tornado et nambayag na taloran oras.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Sayan monster storm so walaan na kasil ya 480km/hr.(133m/s;300mph)
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Uusaren na totoo so saray lenses parad magnification ed nilibon taon la.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Anggaman ontan,say unaan ya telescope so nanlapud Europe nen koma-16siglo.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Sarayan telescope so walaan na kombinasyon na duaran lenses pian ombaleg tan onlinew so object.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Say agum tan siblet ed sipor ya walad too tan no say sakey et dakel so nagunggunaan to, onlesa so inkamasiblet.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Komon naisip na amin ya say maabig ya pikokopera ed balang sakey so sankaabigan ya gawaen.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Dakel a totooy mamapangarap ya sarag la komon na too so manbiahe paonlad sananey a bitewen tan diskobrien iray arum nin mundo, saray arum et mankelaw no anto kasi wala ditan, tan papanisiaan na arum ya saray alien odino arum nin bilay et nayarin manbilay ed arum ya tanaman.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Pero no bilang ta nagawa iya, nayarin magano labat. Saray bitewen et pigaran trilyon a milya so kaarawi da ed "kaabay" dan bitewen.
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Siguro onsabi panaon, saray apo yod pueg et wala lad mundo na saray alien ya mankelaw no siopa ray nanlapuan dan poli.
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Saray ayayep so walaan nya dakel ya cells.Mangan ira tan man -digest ira.Sarag day ongalawgalaw.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Walaay utek so saray ayayep.(say jellyfish so anggapoy utek)
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Saray ayayep so naromog ed interon dalin.Wala ra ed dalem na dalin,diad dayat tan mantekkiab.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Say cell so sankamelagan ya unit na organism.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Nanlapu ed Latin ya salita so cell ya cella kabaliksan to small room.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: No nengnengen mo ed microscope singa iraya small squares o balls.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Anengneng nen Robert Cooke,biologist ed England diad microscope ya singa ankekelag ya square iraya.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Singa ira kuarto. Sikatoy inmunan akaobserbay inatey a selula..
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Say element tan compound so onlipatlipat balet mansiasia iraya tan agnasalatan.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Say nitrogen et mipara ed property na nitrogen gas. Makapal so likido to balet say molecule to et andi.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Sakey ya example so water.Say compound water et walaan na duaran hydrogen atoms tan sakey oxygen atom.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Walaan na parehon molecular structure balanglan gas,liquid o solid.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Say physical state to et nasalatan,say chemical state to mansiansian.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Say oras so walad balang sakey balet apektaen na saya so amin tan mairap ya talosan.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Inaral so oras na saray scholar,religion,philisopical tan science.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Say oras et serye na saray ebento diad kaplesan,diad linmabas tan diad arapen.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Nikompara tayo so oras ed saray karukey na saray ebento.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Natandaan so ilalabas na oras diad pangimano ed saray nagagawa.Say ilalabas na ebento et paulit ulit labat.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Saray computer natan et uusaren ed pictures tan video.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Saray animation et ginawa ed computer, dakel ed sayan klase na animation et uusaren ed telebisyon tan pelikula.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Saray kansion et nirerecord ed saray computer pian naayus iray sounds da.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Nen saman ya panaon nen koma-labinsiam tan koma-duamplon siglo,panisiaan ya say inmunan totoo ed New Zealand et saray Maori,ya mangeerel na baleg ya manok ya moas.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Say theory et say Maori et nanayam ed Polynesia,tan kinobkob da so NewZealand manlapud Moriori,ya angiletneg ira na agrikultura.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Anggaman onman, isusuheri na balon ebidensya ya say Moriori et kabiangan ed grupo na mainland Maori ya inmalis manlapud New Zealand paonlad Chatham Islands, pian paaliwagsey sarili dan kultura.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Wala met so sananey a tribu na Chatham islands saray Maori ya inmalis manlapud New Zealand.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Tinawag day sarili da ya Moriori wala ray daiset ya skirmishes ed bandad sampot, say Moriori et nakal.
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Tinulongan kami na kada indibidwal ya kaibad samploran dekada ya naapresyay maong ya abilidad mi tan passion legan men uusisaen iray impakairapan tan ipakatumba mi.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Legan ya ondedengel ed kada indibidwal ya manginabang nipakaar ed sikara, pamilya, tan istorya na organisasyon, akaaral kamiy importanten karunongan tungkol ed apalabas tan arum nin personalidad ya maong so impluwensya to odino maoges ed kultura na organisasyon.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Say pakatalos ed history na sakey et agmakabaliksan ya pakatalos ed kultura, balet makakatulong anggad panon ya makaaral nipaakar ed history na organisasyon.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Legan ya panusisa ed iyaaligwas tan kakapuyan, naamtaan na kada indibidwal tan say amin ya mibibiang so mas aralem ya impormasyon nipaakar ed prinsipyo, misyon, tan say igagalaw na organisasyon.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Ed onian inkagawa, no nonoten so apalabas ya inkagawa nipakaar ed entrepreneurial behavior ya nanresultad intalona et makatulong ed saray totoo ya magmaliw ya lukas ed saray balon pananguman tan balon direksyon para lokal simbaan.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Saratan ya maabig ya istorya et akabawas ed takot ya panguman, legan ya manggagaway maong ya panagisip parad arapen.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Say impantitipon a paraan na panagnunot et sakey ya metodo para ed panagsolba na problema. Saya et impansasakey da so nanduruman ideya tan lawak na kanunotan pian makaanap ira na solusyon.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Say peles, lohika tan inkaduga, ontan met ed panag-anap na katuaan, say panangiyaplika lamet ed dati lan teknik, tan panagtipon na impormasion so pokus na sayan estiloy panagnunot.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Walay saksakey ya dugan ebat: satan so pinakaimportanten kabiangan na sayan kipapasen na panagnunot. Say nunoten labat et duaran ebat, say duga odino say aliwa.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Sayan tipo na panagnunot et konektado ed pihon siensia tan ed kaslakan ya proseso.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Lohikal so panagnunot na sarayan tipo na totoo. Sarag da ya ikabisa so saray uunoren, iresolba so problema tan gawaen iray sientipiko ya test.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Saray totoo so sankatalentoan ya makabasay nononoten na arum.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Labay ton ibaga ed sarag tayon naamtaan no antoy nononoten na arum, panlabayan, papanisiaan, pakaamta odino say pilalek.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Ed amin ya sarayan abilidad, sankairapan ya talosan so intensyon na arum. Tulongan to tayon resolbien iray aliwliwan kagagawa.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Alimbawa, no makanengneng kay too ya agmo kabat ya bebetagen toy bintana, siguradon isipen mo ya sasalien ton takewen so kotse.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Sikatoy ukomen no nabalang toy tumbok na kotse to tan no say bebetagen to manaya et say mismon kotse to.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Say MRI et base ed physics phenomenon ya tatawagey nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), ya adiskobre nen Felix Bloch sanen 1930’s (mantratrabaho ed Stanford University) tan si Edward Purcell (manlapud Harvard University).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Ed sayan resonance, say magnetic field tan radio waves et makawalay atoms pian mangiter na makalnan radio signals.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Nen 1970, adiskobre nen Raymond Damadian, sakey ya doktor tan research scientist so pangusar na magnetic resonance imaging parad pan-diagnose na saray sakit.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Kayari na apat taon et naaprobaan itan tan nagmaliw ya sankaunaan ya naisyuan na lisensya ed MRI field.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Nen 1977, asumpal nen Dr. Damadian ya ginawa so sankaunaan ya "interon laman" ya MRI scanner, ya tinawag ton "Agnatalo."
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Say sansakey ya pansalita et makatulong pian nakabat tan makapitongtong irad arum.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Ontutulong iyad saray estudyante ya manaral dependid kapeles ya labay da tan pati kapeles na panagbangat.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ontan met, daiset labat so posiblin restriksion ed oras no flexible so oras na trabaho. (Bremer, 1998)
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Lapud Internet tan World Wide Web, mas mainomay ya makalay impormasyon iray estudyante anggan anton oras.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Sarag met na saray estudyante so mantepet ed saray instructor da anggan anton oras tan naebatan da ran tampol, imbes ya alagaren da ni so ontumbok ya face-to-face ya klase da.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Say postmodern approach ya paraan na panag-aral et aglabat akadepende ed saksakey ya paraan. Aliwa labat ya saksakey so paraan pian makaaral.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Diad tua, aliwa labat ya saksakey so nepeg ya aralen. Makaaral so sakey panamegley na saray eksperiensya to tan saray impormasyon ya nibabangat ed sikato.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Napaneknekan iya ed peles ya gagawaen mi ya do-it-yourself iran avtivity, pangiprepresenta na impormasyon, tan programa ed telebisyon ya pakaaralan.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Dakel ed sikami so manbabantay na programa ed telebisyon ya mangiiter na impormasyon ed sakey ya proseso odino eksperiensya ya agmin balot pibiangan odino iyaplika iray naaralan mi.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Agkami man-overhaul na kotse, manggaway fountain ed sular mi, manbiahe ed Peru pian panaralan iray daan tan aderal-deral iran bilding, odino i-remodel so abung na kaabay mi.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Salamat ed koneksion ed dalem na dayat ya optic fiber tan broadband satellite ed Europe, ta say 93% ya populasyon na Greenland et maka-access ed internet.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Say hotel odino hosts (no manayam ed guesthouse o pribadon abung) et malamang ya walaay wifi o internet connected PC, tan amin ya ayaman et walaay internet cafe odino diad arum ya lugar et walay wifi parad publiko.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Singa abitIad tagey, anggaman aawaten ni so salitan "Eskimo" ed United States, ipapasen itan ya panIegIemew ed dakeI ya aIiwan U.S. Arctic ya totoo, nagkaIaotIa diad Canada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Anggano narerengel yon bibitlaen na saray katutubon taga-GreenIand iray salita, ag nayarin usaren itan na saray estranghero.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Saray taga-GreenIand et tatawagen day inkasikaran Inuit diad Canada tan KaIaaIIeq (no dakelan Kalaallit), GreendIander, diad GreenIand.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Say krimen, tan aliwan panagtrato ed saray dayo et ag-anggan amta na saray taga Greenland. Anggan diad saray baley et anggapoy "lugar ya mapeligro."
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Say ambetel ya panaon labat so nayarin sakey ed saray peligro no agmanparaan.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: No ombisita ka ed Greenland legan na ambetel ya panaon (isip mo ya no onaasingger ka lan onaasingger ed amianen et mas ombebetel), importante so pangawit na ampetang iran kawes.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Say andukey ya agew kada tiagew so rason no akin ya nakulangan kay ugip tan mansakit ka.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Kada tiagew, manalwar ka met ed ageyet ya Nordic. Anggano ag-ira mangiyalis na sakit, makapairita iratan.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Anggaman kasali ed world-class tourist attraction so San Francisco lapud ekonomiya to, manguman-uman so ekonomiya to.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Say sankabalegan a sektor na trabaho et professional services, gobierno, finance, trade, tan turismo.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Say naynay ya pangiyaakto ed musika, pelikula, literatura tan kabkabat ya kultura so tinmulong ed siudad pian nakabkabat ed intiron mundo.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Angipaalagey so San Francisco na baleg ya bilding parad turista, dakel so hotel to, restawran tan manunaan ya pasilidad na kombensiyon.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Sakey so San Francisco ed saray sankaabigan ya lugar ed mundo parad arum ya luto ed Asia: Korean, Thai, Indian tan Japanese.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Say panbiyahe paonlad Walt Disney World et irerepresenta toy mayorya ed pilgrimage parad dakel ya Amerikanon pamilya.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Say "typical" ya ibisita et say iyunlad Orlando International Airport, ilugan ed bus paonlad Disney hotel, mansiansiad man na sakey simba tan ag-onaalis ed lugar na Disney, tan ipawil ed abung.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Agmangangga so posiblen rason, balet aya so kaslakan ya labay ya ibaga na totoo no ibabaga day "iyunlad mundo na Disney".
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Dakel ya ticket ya ilalako ed online diad panamegley na subasta ed website singa say eBay odino Craigslist et manguusar no maminsan na multi-day park-hopper ya ticket.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Anggano kabkabat iyan aktibidad, inbawal tan na Disney: aga naipasa e arum iray ticket.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Amin ya pankampo ed kaliberliber na Grand Canyon et mankaukoIan na backcountry permit.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: AIimitaan so permit pian naprotektaan so canyon, tan lukas itan diad ononan agew na buIan, apat buIan ni antes na bulan ya igapo.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Kanian, say backcountry permit ya onggapo na Mayo et nayarin naala no Enero 1.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Say espasyo parad saray pinakasikat ya pasen, singa say Bright AngeI Campground ya kaabay na Phantom Ranch, et kaslakan ya napapano na request diad unonan agew ya Iukas la iratan parad pangireserba.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Limitado so permit ya akareserba parad saray bigIaan ya onsabi, tan say onaan ya onsabi sikatoy onaan ya naserbian.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: No manbiahe ka paonlad Southern Africa panamegley na kotse, naliketan ka ta nanengneng mo ray mararakep ya pasen tan makakar ka met ed saray papasyaran na saray turista ditan.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Nayarin usaren so normal ya kotse balet kaukolan ya iplano ya maong. Mas marakep no 4x4 so usaren ta say dakel ya pasen et naonlaan labat no 4x4 so usaren.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: No manplaplano, tandaan ya anggano maong so kipapasen na Southern Africa, saray arum ya kaabay ton bansa balet et andi.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Saray kakaukolanen tan nagastos parad visa et nandudumaan diad kada bansa tan depende ed no anton bansa so nanlapuan mo.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Say kada bansa et walaan met na kanya-kanyan totontonen no antoran gamit parad emergency so nepeg ya walad luluganan.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Say baley na Victoria falls et walad western portion na Zimbabwe,diad border na Livingstone,Zambia ,tan dia ed Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Say kulaay baley et asingged diad kulaay falls,manunan atraksyon,balet sayan popular tourist destination so mangiiter na parehon adventure tan dakel ya nanengneng ed saray manbayag.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Say mauran ya panaon(November ya anggad March)say danum so onlepua tan say falls so napano.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Seguradon nabasa so sakey no onlad brudge ya sungger ed falls.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Diad arum ya banda,magenap labat lapud say tagey na danum et manlepua ya singa la actual ya nanengneng so falls-ya onlelepuya ed danum.
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Say Tomb of Tutankhamun(KV62),KV62 so sakey ed saray famous ya tomb diad Valley,say the Scene of Howard Carter's 1922,adiskobri lubok na sayan ari.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Kompara ed arum ya royal tombs,say tomb nen Tutankhamun so matalag ya bisitaen,mas melag tan daiset so dekorasyon.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Siopaman ya interesado ed impakaderal na mummy diad impangekal ed coffin so nadismaya lapud say ulo tan taklay labat so nanengneng.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Say engranden yaman na tomb so naandi,saya so inekal ed Egyptian Museum ed Cairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Saray limitadoy oras da so makapanpasyar labat anggan iner.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Say Phnom Krom et 12km ed Siem Reap.Sayan nipaalagey ya templo ed tuktok so inletneg nen koma-9 siglo, legan na uley na arin Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Say makulimlim ya atmospera ed templo tan say view ed Tonle Sap lake et talagan peneken toy isegep mo.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Say ibisita ed lugar et marakep no onlugan ed barko paunlad look.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Say Angkor Pass so kaukolan no onloob ed templo manepeg labat ya ag lilingwanay passport no paunla ed Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Say Jerusalem et capital city tan sankabalgan ya city na Israel,anggano ag iya birbiren na United Nations bilang capital na Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Say daan ya syudad ed Judean Hills so walaan na makapakelaw ya history diad nilibon taon.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Say syudad et masanto tan walaan na taloran monotheistic religion-Judaism,Christianity,tan Islam,kinmana iya ya spiritual,religious ,tan cultural center.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Lapud kaimportantian na relihyon ed syudad,lalo ed saray Old city iran lugar,say Jerusalem et nagmaliw ya tourist destination na Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Say Jerusalem et walaan na historic,archeological tan cultural sites,kabiangan so saray shopping malls,cafés,tan restaurants.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Kaukolan so invitation letter ed Ecuador diad saray Cuban citizens no sikaray ompasok ed Ecuador diad airport odino diad saray admission.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Kaukolan ya na-legalized iya ed Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs tan ipasa iray manunan requirements.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Sayan requirements et manepeg pian naorganisa so panayam diad parehon bansa.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Saray Cuban citizen ya walaay US green card so onlad Ecuadorian Consulate pian agla iter iray requirements.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Say passport ed valid labat na 6months manlapud panbiahe.Say roundtrip ticket so kaukolan ya ipanengneng.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Mas mamura so tour no group,no bokor mo labat odino walay kaarum mas maong so manporma na group ed odino anemira pian mamura so bayaran kada sakey too.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Agmet iya masyadon problema lapud saray tourist et panbibiigan da no walad luganan la.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Mas dakel so naluko da nen say manisia iray totoo ya baleg so bayaran.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Matatayug diad bandad amianen na parten amianen na Machu Picchu so ayan atagey a palandey ya maslak ya sa backdrop na litrato na saray ageba.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Medyo makapataktakot ed leksab,atagey tan mairap so onkalab,say fit labat so makakalab ed 45 minutes.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Mabato so dalan,tan no patagey la walay handgrail ya bembenan.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Nikuan la,talagan abet-abeten so paningas,asikasoen ya maong no patagey,lalo no ambasa,peligro so dadalanen.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Walay melag ya cave ya asinger ed tuktok ya nadalanan,mankalna labat tan ompeket ya maong.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Say inengneng ed lugar na Galapagos et panamegley na bangka,singa ginawa nen Charles Darwin nen 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Masulok ya 60 cruise ship so ondadalan ed Galapagos,mga 8 -100 so passengers.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Say arum et advance la ya mangibook.(say barko so mainomay ya napano no high seasin)
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Siguradoen ya Galapagos specialist so agent ya nakatongtong ya walaan na kakabatan ed nanduruman barko.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Papaseguroan na barko ya matched so saray iilaloan na saray onlugan.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Antis ya sinmabi iray Spanish nen koma-16 ya siglo, say amianen ya Chile et uuleyan na Inca, legan ya saray indigenous Araucanian (Mapuche) et manaayam ed sentro tan amianen na Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Saray Mapuche met so sakey ed saray sampot lan independentin indigenous ya grupo ed America, ya agmasyadon naimpluensiyaan na ganggan ya mansalitay Spanish anggad nen nagmaliw lan independenti so Chile.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Anggano nagmaliw ya independente so Chile nen 1810 (kapegleyan na Napoleonic ya guerra ya rason no akin ya anggapoy gobiernon nanuley ed Spain diad loob na duay taon), nibagan atalo labat so Spain nen 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Say Dominican RepubIic (Spanish: RepubIica Dominica) et bansa ed Caribbean ya nansakop ed kapaIdua na mamabukig ya isIa na HispanioIa, tan kaapag toy Haiti
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Likud ed amputin buer na kadayatan tan pinmugaron kapaIandeyan, say bansa so ayaman na sangkabayagan Ian syudad na saray Europeano diad saray America ya natan et kabiangan na Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Say isla et inmunan impanayaman na saray Taínos tan Caribes. Saray Caribes et totoon mansasaIita na Arawakan ya sinmabi nen manga 10,000 BCE.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Diad Ioob na pigaran taon manlapud insabi na saray managsukimat ya taga-Europa, say popuIasyon na saray Tainos et dinmaiset ya maong Iapud saray EspanyoI ya managsakop
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Base ed Fray BartoIome de Ias Casas (Tratado de Ias Indias) diad baetan na 1492 tan 1498 et pinatey na saray managsakop ya EspanyoI so manga 100,000 ya Tainos.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Union. Sayan lugar et ginawa bilang sentro na kombento nen koma-17 ya siglo, say Templo de San Diego so akera labat ed saya.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Uusaren la ya natan bilang central plaza, tan dakel so nagagawa ditan kada agew tan labi.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Dakel iray restaurant ya akapaliber ed hardin, tan kada ngarem tan labi ditan et wala ray libren concert ya gaganapen ed central gazebo.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Duaran balkonahe ya manarawian labat na 69 sentimetro, ibabaga dan dia agawa so sakey ya istorya na aroan.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Diad pigara labat ya barya, wala ray ugugaw ya mangistorya ed sika ed satan.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Sikat so Bowen Island ed day trip odino excursion ed sampot-simba tan sarag mo dia so man-kayak, man-hiking, man-shopping, mangan ed restaurant, tan dakel ni.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Sayan komunidad et walad Howe Sound ya asingger labat ed Vancouver, tan mainomay ya laen panamegley na saray aka-eskedyul ya water taxi ya onalis ed Granville Island diad downtown na Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Diad saramay labalabay day outdoor activity, balibali so manpasyar ed Sea to Sky corridor.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Say Whistler (1.5 ya oras ya biahe manlapud Vancouver) et mabli balet kabkabat lapud agawa dia so 2010 Winter Olympics.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: No winter, sali yo so arum ed saray balibalin skiing diad North America, tan diad tiagew sali yoy man-mountain biking.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Masakbay lan ipapareserba iray permit. Kaukolan ya walay permit mo no man-overnight ka ed Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Say Sirena labat so ranger station ya mangiyoopresi na dormitoryon ugipan tan kapanluton naakan bilang kaaruman ed camping. Say La Leona, San Pedrillo, tan Los Patos et mangiyoopresi labat na camping pero agkaibay naakan.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Posiblen makala na permit manlapu mismo ed Ranger Station diad Puerto Jiménez, balet ag-ira mangaawat na credit card.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Say Park Service (MINAE) et agmangiiter na park permit na masulok ya sakey bulan antis ni na niyeskedyul ya isabi.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Say CafeNet El Sol et mangiyoopresi na reservation ed presyon US$30, odino $10 parad sanage ya passes; say arum ya detalye et walad Corcovado page.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Say Cook Islands et sakey ya bansa walad isla ya bulos ya makakaonla ed New Zealand, wala iyad Polynesia, diad pegley na South Pacific Ocean.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Ayan arkipelago et sakop toy 15 ya isla ya walad masulok ya 2.2 milyon km2 na dayat.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Lapud pareho so oras na saya ed Hawaii, no maminsan et tatawagen iyan isla bilang "Hawaii down under".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Anggaman melag iya, ipapanonot na saya ed saray arum ya maedad lan ombibisita so Hawaii nen agni kaiba ed state tan anggapo ni ray angkakabaleg ya hotel parad turista tan arum ni ran inaligwasan.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Say Cook Island et anggapo ray syudad to balet walaan iya na 15 ya nanduruman isla. Say manuna ed saraya et say Rarotonga tan Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Diad saray maaligwas ya bansa, say pangitarya na deluxe bed tan breakfast so nagmaliw ya pormay art.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Say manunaan et,say B&Bs so mapatnag ya mikokompetensiya ed duaran bengatla say: bedding tan breakfast
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Miulibay ed saya, say marakep ya panagayos na saray bedding et say pangusar na handmade quilt odino antique ya bed.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Kabiangan na almusal so seasonal delights na rehiyon odino say specialty dish na host.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Say setting et historic art building ya walaan na antique furnitures,manicured grounds tan swimming pool.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Say pangusar na sarilin luganan ed biahe so makagungguna tan simply.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Aliwan singa saray ankabaleg iran lulugan familiar kala ed luluganan mo tan antam la iray limitasyon to.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Say pangusar na tent ed agmo property so man-attract na attention na arum.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Diad antikey a salita, say pangusar na sarilin luganan so sankaabigan balet andi no man-"camp".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Nayari met so car camping no say luluganan mo et large minivan,SUV,Sedan o Station Wagon,ya walaan na yurongan ya napandukolan.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Saray arum ya hotel et walaan na saray heritage diad saray dadalanan ya railways tan diad liber na saray dayat antis na World war II nen koma-19 tan 20 siglo.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Sarayan hotel et mayaman tan sikat nensaman,tan walaan na fine dinning tan nightlife.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Saray old fashion fittings,kakulangan na function,saray matikas ya mamatatken so kabiangan ed character.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Dakel so private ya akankayarian,sikaray manbibisita ed saray head of state odino walaay atagey ya estado.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Say mayaman ya traveller et makapan around the world,tan manayam ed sarayan hotels.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Say hospitality exchange network,so mangikokonek ed saray travellers ed lokal diad saray syudad ya bisitaen da.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Say pisali ed satan ya network et mankaukolan na form ya pipirmaan online; anggaman saray arum et mananap na saray requirements odino verification.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Saray listaan na available iran hosts so niiter diad print odino online,arum so walaan na references.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Say Couchsurfing so ginmapo nen January 2004 kayarin naalmoan nen Casey Fenton,sakey ya computer programmer so cheap flight ed Iceland balet anggapoy natuloyan.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Sikato et nan-email ed saray lokal ya estudyante ed unibersidad tan akaawat na amayamay a offer parad free accomodation.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Saray hostels so nigana parad kalangweran,saray maneded ya bente so saray guest,bangbalet wala met iray maedad laran travellers.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Saray pamilyan walay anak da et matalag a nanengneng, balet saray arum ya hostels et aabuloyan ira diad private rooms.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Say syudad na Beijing ed China so sakey ed saray host no Olympic Winter Games no 2022, ya sayan syudad et unaan ya host legay summer tan winter.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Say Beijing so host manlapud opening tan closing ceremony tan diad saray indoor ice events.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Saray arum ya skiing event et diad Taizicheng ski area diad Zhangjiacou, manga 220 km (140 milya) manlapud Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Karaklan ed saray templo et walaan na annual festival ya onggapo ed November tan manampot ed kapegleyay May,depende ed say annual calendar ed templo.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Dakel ed saray templo so maneselebra na anniversary,mitumbokan ed Kerala temple festivals,odino arum niran events.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Makapasagyat so Kerala festival, walay prosesyon na saray elepante, wala met so orkestra tan saray pagalaw legay Kerala festival.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Say World's fair (Expo) so large international ya fiesta ed arts tan science
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Saray kabiangan ya bansa so walaan na artistic tan national display ed pavillions,pian ipanengneng so saray culture tan history na saray bansa.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Say International Horticultural Expositions so marunong ed saray walaan panpasikat ed floral display,botanical garden odino antokaman ya misiglaotan ed tanaman.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Diad theory nagawaan da so saraya kada tinaon(basta wala ed sananey ya bansa),balet agda susumpalen.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Sarayan ebento so manampot ed talora tan anim bulan,tan gagawaen ed melag ya pasen ya 50 hectares labat.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Dakel iray nanduruman format na films diad inlabas na taon.Say standard ed 35mm film (36 by24 mm negative) tan sikatoy common.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Mainomay ya kargaan lamet no naupot iya.Tan walaan na resolution ya mipara ed DLSR.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Arum ya medium camera et walaan na 6 by 6cm format,suston sukat na 56 by 56mm negative.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Saya so mangiter ed resolution ya manga apatiran beses nen say 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Saray ayayep so sakey ed saray sankairapan ya alaay litrato na saray photographer, tan kaukolan so kombinasyon ya swerte, anos, tan eksperiensyado ira tan walay marakep ya gamit da.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Mabebet ya ibabaliwala so panlitrato ed saray ayayep, balet singa saray litrato, dakel so kabaliksan na saratan.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Pian nalitrato iray ayayep, mabetbet ya kaukolan so andukey ya telephoto lens, pero no say litratoen mo et grupo na saray manok odino sakey ya angkelag ya pinalsa, kaukolan moy arum ya lens.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Dakel ed saray nikadkaduman ayayep et mairap ya anapen, tan wala ray totontonen na saray park nipaakar ed panlitrato ed sikara no usaren itan parad negosyo.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Saray atap ya ayep et nayarin mabaing odino agresibo. Say ayaman da et nayarin ambetel, ampetang, odino maatap.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Walay masulok ya 5,000 ya nanduruman lenguahe ed mundo, kaiba la ditan so duamplo nin lenguahe ya uusaren na 50 milyon odino onsulok ni ya totoo.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Mabetbet ya mas mainomay ya talosan iratan no isulat nen say no isalita. Lalo la ed saray address, a mabetbet ya mairap ya ibalikas.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Dakel ya bansa so maong ya mansalitay English, tan anggan saramay daiset ni inaral da - lalo la ray kabataan.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Isip mon sakey kan Mascunian, Bostonian, Jamaican tan Sydneysider ya akairong ya mamangan ed lamisaan diad sakey ya restaurant ed Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Mangi-istorya irad sakey tan sakey nipaakar ed baley da, ya walay tono na panagsalita da tan diad mismon dialekto da.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Say pangaliw ed saray supermarket so mabetbet ya sankatipidan ya paraan pian makapangan. No agnayari manluto, sarag moy mangaliw na aluto lan naakan.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Ondadakel iray paraan na saray supermarket pian makasaliw kay aluto lan naakan. Say arum ingen et wala lay in-microwave odino arum nin paraan pian ipapapetang so naakan.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Diad arum ya bansa odino diad arum ya lakoan, walay sakey ya restaurant, ya mabetbet et aliwan masyadon pormal pero mamura iray naakan.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Dapat walay awit mon kopya na policy tan detalye na insurer contact mo.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Kaukolan dan ipanengneng ed insurer so e-mail address tan numero na telepono dad arum a bansa parad suhestion/autorisasyon tan pan-claim.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Nawalaan na sananey ya kopya ed bagahem tan online (i-send mod email mo ya kaibay attachment, odino iyan ed "cloud").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: No walay awit mon laptop odino tablet computer, mangiyan na kopya ed memory na satan odino diad disc (ya nayarin lukasan anggano anggapoy internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Ontan met mangiter na policy/kopya na saray contact ed saray kaiban manbiahe tan kanayon odino kakaaro ya atilak ed abung ya maliket ya ontulong.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Saray moose (odino kabkabat met bilang elk) et aliwan sipor ya agresibo, balet iyagel day sarili da no nalikas dan walay peligro odino panangataki.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: No ag ibilang na totoo so moose ya nayarin delikado, nayarin onasingger iran maong tan sarag dan iyakar so sarili dad peligro.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Kabkaabigan ya uninom na de-alkohol ya iinumen. Duma so epekto tod kada too, importante ya amtam so limitasyon odino amay nasarag mo.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Wala ray mabayag ya epekto na sobsobran panag-inum ed bunigas, kaiba lay pakaderal na altey, anggan pakabulag tan ipapatey. Say posibilidad na peligro et mas baleg no oninum na ilegal iran de-alkohol ya produkto.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Ilegal iran spirits et posiblin manlugan na nanduruman delikadon dutak, kaiba lay methanol, ya posiblin makabulag odino makapatey anggano daiset labat.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Saray salming parad mata et mamura ed arum ya bansa, lagkalalo lad saray bansan abebay anap da ya no iner say suweldod pankimey et abeba.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: I-konsidera ya manpa-eksamin na mata ed abung, lagkalalo la no sakop na insurance so nagastos, tan awiten so reseta pian ni-rekord ed arum ya pasen.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Iramay mararakep tan sikat ya frame na salming ya nasaliw ed saratan ya lugar et walaan na duaran problema; say arum et peke, tan saramay tua ya nanlapud arum ya bansa et posiblin mabmabli nen say diad lokal ya pasen.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Say kape et sakey ed saray sankasaliwan ya commodity,tan makaanap ka ed abung ya nanlapud nanduruman rehiyon.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Anggaman kuan,walay nanduruman paraan na mundo pian inumen so kape,tan talagan marakep iyan eksperiensya.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Say Canyoning(canyoneering i.e)ya onloob ed dalem na canyon balanglan amaga odino napnoy danum.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Say combination na canyoning et swimming,climbing tan jumping,daiset ya training labat so kaukolan.(kumpara ed rock climbing,scuba diving,odino alpine skiing i.e)
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Say hiking et sakey ya outdoor activity ya manakar pian nanengneng so dakep na palsa.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Say day hiking et panakar ed sakey milya ya nagawaan ed sakey agew.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Parad day hike say daiset ya preparasyon so magenap,tan say katamtaman ya laman so ayus met la.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Saray pamilyan daiset so ananak so kaukolay preparasyon,balet say day hike et marakep parad saray babies tan pre-school children.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Internationally,wala so ngalngalin 200 running tour oranizations.Karaklan et independent so operation da.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Say Global Running Tour successors,so walaan na apatiran kontinente ya aasikasoey Go Running Tours networks.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Nanugat ed Running Tours Barcelona diad Barcelona tan Running Copenhagen diad Copenhagen, saya et maples ya pinilaan na Running Tours Praque tan arum nira.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Dakel so nepeg ya ikonsidera,antis ya manbiahe ed inerman.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: No manbiahe nonoten ya aliwan abung so kawalaan.Saray ugali,ley,panangan,traffic,lodging,standards,lenguahe,tan arum so miduma ed no iner so nanlapuan
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Dakel so nepeg ya kaukolan ya isipen,pian aga nadismaya,seguro say pakataway ed lokal iran bengatla.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Saray travel agency so ginmapo nen 19th century.Say sakey ya travel agent so maung ya option parad panbiahe pian makapanbayag ya naeksperiensya so nature,language,tan culture.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Anggaman dakel ed saray agency so walaan na regular bookings,dakel ya agent so marunong ed partikular ya pambiahe,no kaunongay budget tan destinasyon.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Mas magmaong no apasakey so agent ya mangi-book ed saray datin biahe.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Nengnengen no antoray partikular ya promotion na saray agent,diad website odino shop window.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: No labay moy man-tour ed mundo ya mamura, lapud talagan kaukolan, kabibilay odino parad challenge, wala ray paraan ya nagawaan mo itan.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Walay duaran kategorya: Legay biahe, mantrabaho ka o limitaan moy gastos mo. Akapokus iyan artikulo ed panlimitay gastos.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Parad saramay akaparaan ya isakripisyoy inkakomportable da, say panaon tan say pannonot ed posiblen nagawa et ontulong pian daiset so nagastos mo tan agka tanton manggastos.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Saray managbiahe et agmantatakew, ag-ondadalan ed bawal, agmibibiang ed ilegal ya transaksyon, agmipapayabol, odino agmansasamantala ed arum ya totoo parad sarilin pankaabigan da.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Diad immigration checkpoint so unonan tundaan kaepas ed eroplano, barko, o anggan anton luluganan.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Diad arum ya boundary, wala ray inspection legan ya onaandar so tren tan kaukolan ya walay valid ID ya awit mo no onlugan kad saratan ya tren.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Diad saray tren ya night sleeper, Saray pasaporte et nayarin kolektaen na konduktor pian agnadisturboy ugip mo.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Say pamparehistro so kaaruman ya requirement ed panproseso na visa. Diad arum a bansa, personal a manparehistro ka kaiba lay address mo diad saray lokal ya autoridad.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Nayarin kaukolay manpirma na form ed lokal ya pulis odino onlad saray opisinay immigration.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Diad dakel a bansa ya walay ontan ya ley, saray hotel lay manayos ed panagrehistro (basta tepet mo).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Diad arum, saramay manaayam ed paway na saray ayaman na turista so kaukolan labat ya manparehistro. Balet ompan agka segurado ed ley kanian mas maong no mantepet ka la.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Say arkitektura et nipaakar ed disenyo tan pangipaalagey na saray building. Say arkitektura na sakey a lugar et nipasen met lan sakey ya tourist attraction.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Dakel ya bilding so marakep a nengnengen tan say bista manlapud atagey ya bilding odino manlapud bintanan bali-bali so posisyon et talagan nibagan karakpan.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Say Arkitektura et kaibad arum ya lawak kaiba lay urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design tan landscape design.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Lapud arawdawi iray pueblos, agka makaromog ditan na malaem ya nightlife no agka onlad Albuquerque odino Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Anggaman ontan, ngalngali amin ya casino ya abitla et mangiyo-oprisi na iinumen, ya arum ed satan et name-brand ya entertainment (primero la iray baleg iran casino diad paliber na Albuquerque tan Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Manalwar: saray bar ed maleg iran baley et aliwan lanang ya marakep a pasen parad saray dayon bisita pian pasyaran.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Sakey la, say amianen a pasen ed New Mexico et walaan na seryoson problema nipaakar ed panmaneho anggano abuek, sarayan akainum ya drayber et niyapasakey diad saray bar ed melag iran baley.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Saray ag labay ya mural o sulat ed pader et tatawagen ya graffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Arawi ed modernon inkasikat,say karaklan et isisiglaot da ed youth vandalizing diad public tan private property ya manguusar na saray spray ya pinta.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Balet diad sarayan panaon wala iray kabkabat ya graffiti artists, graffiti events tan "legal" ya pader. Saray graffiti paintings ed sayan konteksto so nibagan sakey ya artwork imbes ya illegal tags.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Say Boomerang Throwing so kabkabat ya skill ya labay na toristan aligen.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: No labay mon aralen so man-boomerang ya ompawil ed limam, kaukolan ya walaan na suston boomerang pian ompawil.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Karaklan ya boomerang ed Australia et agla pinmawil,mas maong no ag iya salien diad panaon na maragem.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Say Hangi meal et lulutoen diad ginawan abot na dalin.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Say abot so papetangen diad saray baton pinapetang,diad arum ya lugar say geothermal heat so pagmaliwen ton ampetang so dalin.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Say hangi so iluluto ed traditional roast style no pandem.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Dakel ya lugar ed Rotorua so mangi-aalok na geothermal hangi,say arum ya hangi et samoke na Christchurch,Wellington tan arum ni.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Say Metrorail et walaan na duaran klase na commuter trail diad loob tan paway na Cape Town:Metro Plus (atawag ya First class) tan Metro (atawag ya Third class).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Say metroplus et mas komportable tan daiset so too,pero mamabli,anggano mamura so tickets ed Europe.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Say Easy train so walaan na Metroplus tan metro coaches,saray Metroplus coaches so walad sampot na train ya asingger ed Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Say itulong ed arum-naynay ya imanoen so kulaay bag,nagkalautla no babaliwen iray international borders.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Nayarin nakargaay drugs so bag mo no amo iya imanoen,ya ompasubo ka ed bsleg ya problema.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Saya so nagagawa ed waiting lines,saray drug-sniffinv dogs so uusaren ed anggan anton oras.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Arum ya bansa so walaan na ambelat ya punishment anggano first offense labat,kabiangan na saya so pakakulong na 10 years odino ipatey.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Saray apulyanan ya bags so mainomay ya natakewan tan lapuan na pakapanduaruwa na saray bomb threats no maminsan.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Lapud mikrobyo diad abung, apasal lay laman mo ed satan.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Balet diad arum ya parte na dalin, no agka pamilyar ed bacteriological fauna, mas dakle so onlesan problema.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Ontan met, no mas ampetang so panaon mas maples ya ondakel so bakterya tan mas mairap a pateyen ed paway na laman.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Samay salot na Delhi Belly, amay sumpa ed Faraon, panagbales na Montezuma, tan saray dakel a kakaaro da.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.
